basic.name: 普通攻击：热身火花
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：烈火
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向身周进行斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：盛燃烈火
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向身周进行强力斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，[普通攻击]和[冲刺攻击]必定触发[火力镇压]，最多持续30秒或触发8次。
招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 可直接衔接至第四段[普通攻击]。
招式发动后，将进入[戒备姿态]；在[戒备姿态]下，若[普通攻击]期间受到敌人攻击，会发动[普通攻击：火力充能]格挡此次攻击，随后发动[普通攻击：火力迸发]，在[普通攻击：火力迸发]发动后点按 【普通攻击键】 可从保留的普攻段数开始发动[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Executes a powerful slash against enemies nearby, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks are guaranteed to trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of a Basic Attack.
Soldier 11 enters the Alert Stance after using this skill. While in Alert Stance, if hit during a Basic Attack, triggers Basic Attack: Fire Charge to block the attack, followed by Basic Attack: Fire Assault. After Basic Attack: Fire Assault is performed, press [Basic Attack] to resume Basic Attack from the retained Basic Attack hit count.

dodge.name: 闪避：退火
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：炽火
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成物理伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：逆火
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Executes a powerful slash against enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：

fields.text: 「11号」在[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]中触发[火力镇压]时，招式造成的伤害提升70%。
fields.textEn: When triggering Fire Suppression during a Basic Attack or Dash Attack, increase that attack's DMG by 70%.

fields.text:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
「11号」造成的火属性伤害提升10%，攻击处于失衡状态下的敌人时，该增益效果额外提升22.5%。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Soldier 11 deals 10% more Fire DMG. When attacking Stunned enemies, this effect is further enhanced by an additional 22.5%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：热身火花
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：火力镇压
basic.description:
在恰当的时机点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
发动更加强力的斩击，造成火属性伤害。
必定触发[火力镇压]的状态下，在进攻即将结束时点按 【普通攻击键】 可更快速地衔接至下一段[普通攻击]。
在必定触发[火力镇压]的状态下，可解锁第五段[普通攻击]，发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，可强化下一次第五段[普通攻击]。强化第五段[普通攻击]发动时可消耗当前所有必定触发[火力镇压]的次数，每消耗一次造成额外火属性伤害。
触发[极限闪避]后，可保留当前普攻段数持续5秒，发动[闪避反击]后点按 【普通攻击键】 可从保留的普攻段数开始发动[普通攻击]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] at the right moment to activate:
Launches a stronger slash, dealing Fire DMG.
When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, pressing [Basic Attack] when the attack is about to end speeds up the transition into the next hit of Basic Attack.
When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, the 5th hit of the Basic Attack string unlocks. Activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate powers up her next Basic Attack 5th hit. A strengthened Basic Attack 5th hit will consume all remaining guaranteed Fire Suppression activations to deal additional Fire DMG per activation spent.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, the current Basic Attack hit count is retained for 5s. After performing a Dodge Counter, pressing [Basic Attack] resumes the Basic Attack from the retained hit count.

basic.name: 普通攻击:火力迸发（潜能觉醒）
basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：[普通攻击：火力充能]
[普通攻击：火力充能]发动过程中松开 【普通攻击键】 时发动[普通攻击：火力迸发]。
[普通攻击：火力迸发]发动过程中或[普通攻击：火力充能]发动瞬间受到敌方攻击时，可触发格挡反击，免疫该次伤害，并额外获得3次必定触发[火力镇压]的次数，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接至第三段[普通攻击]，上限为8次，
在蓄力过程中拖曳摇杆时，可以发动[普通攻击：烈焰奔袭]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate: Basic Attack: Fire Charge
Release [Basic Attack] while Basic Attack: Fire Charge is activated to launch Basic Attack: Fire Assault.
If attacked by an enemy during Basic Attack: Fire Assault or the moment Basic Attack: Fire Charge is activated, a Block Counter can be triggered, negating that instance of DMG and granting 3 guaranteed triggers of Fire Suppression. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack, up to 8 times.
While charging, tilting the joystick launches Basic Attack: Blazing Rush.

在必定触发[火力镇压]的状态下，可解锁第五段[普通攻击]，发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，可强化下一次第五段[普通攻击]。强化第五段[普通攻击]发动时可消耗当前所有必定触发[火力镇压]的次数，每消耗一次造成额外火属性伤害。
触发[极限闪避]后，可保留当前普攻段数持续5秒，发动[闪避反击]后点按 【普通攻击键】 可从保留的普攻段数开始发动[普通攻击]。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] at the right moment to activate:
Launches a stronger slash, dealing Fire DMG.
When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, pressing [Basic Attack] when the attack is about to end speeds up the transition into the next hit of Basic Attack.
When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, the 5th hit of the Basic Attack string unlocks. Activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate powers up her next Basic Attack 5th hit. A strengthened Basic Attack 5th hit will consume all remaining guaranteed Fire Suppression activations to deal additional Fire DMG per activation spent.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, the current Basic Attack hit count is retained for 5s. After performing a Dodge Counter, pressing [Basic Attack] resumes the Basic Attack from the retained hit count.

fields.name: 普通攻击:火力迸发（潜能觉醒）
fields.trigger: 长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：[普通攻击：火力充能]
fields.triggerEn: Hold [Basic Attack] to activate: Basic Attack: Fire Charge
fields.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：[普通攻击：火力充能]
[普通攻击：火力充能]发动过程中松开 【普通攻击键】 时发动[普通攻击：火力迸发]。
[普通攻击：火力迸发]发动过程中或[普通攻击：火力充能]发动瞬间受到敌方攻击时，可触发格挡反击，免疫该次伤害，并额外获得3次必定触发[火力镇压]的次数，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接至第三段[普通攻击]，上限为8次，
在蓄力过程中拖曳摇杆时，可以发动[普通攻击：烈焰奔袭]。
fields.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate: Basic Attack: Fire Charge
Release [Basic Attack] while Basic Attack: Fire Charge is activated to launch Basic Attack: Fire Assault.
If attacked by an enemy during Basic Attack: Fire Assault or the moment Basic Attack: Fire Charge is activated, a Block Counter can be triggered, negating that instance of DMG and granting 3 guaranteed triggers of Fire Suppression. Press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack, up to 8 times.
While charging, tilting the joystick launches Basic Attack: Blazing Rush.

fields.triggerEn: Press [Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:

fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing Fire DMG.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：盛燃烈火

fields.description:

招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 可直接衔接至第四段[普通攻击]。
招式发动后，将进入[戒备姿态]；在[戒备姿态]下，若[普通攻击]期间受到敌人攻击，会发动[普通攻击：火力充能]格挡此次攻击，随后发动[普通攻击：火力迸发]，在[普通攻击：火力迸发]发动后点按 【普通攻击键】 可从保留的普攻段数开始发动[普通攻击]。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Executes a powerful slash against enemies nearby, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks are guaranteed to trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of a Basic Attack.
Soldier 11 enters the Alert Stance after using this skill. While in Alert Stance, if hit during a Basic Attack, triggers Basic Attack: Fire Charge to block the attack, followed by Basic Attack: Fire Assault. After Basic Attack: Fire Assault is performed, press [Basic Attack] to resume Basic Attack from the retained Basic Attack hit count.
